arStrings.szText:
Casting a {c_important}Pyromancy{/c} Skill Immobilizes enemies hit for {c_random}[Affix."Static Value 0" * Affix_Value_1|1|]{/c} seconds.
Casting a {c_important}Shock{/c} Skill grants a burst of {c_random}[Affix."Static Value 1" * Affix_Value_1 * 100 |1%|]{/c} Movement Speed for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 3"]{/c} second.
Casting a {c_important}Frost{/c} Skill grants a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} for {c_random}[Affix."Static Value 2" * Affix_Value_1 * 100 |1%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 4"]{/c} seconds.

While {c_important}Enlightened{/c}, each Skill grants all benefits.
Gain bonuses based on which types of Skills you Cast. While {c_important}Enlightened{/c}, all Skill gain them.
